statement.zh: 江章华《长江上游先秦考古研究》（2022）汇集含成都平原早期城址/宝墩文化在内的上游先秦考古论文。
statement.en: Jiang Zhanghua 2022 collects Pre-Qin upper Yangzi studies including Chengdu Plain early walled sites / Baodun culture.
